Package com.j3d.engine.math.matrix

Interface MatrixInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
Matrix3, Point, Vector3
public interface MatrixInterface
Defines the core contract for a matrix implementation. This interface provides methods for accessing dimensions, getting and setting individual elements, retrieving the underlying data array, and creating a copy of the matrix. It also includes a default method for generating a formatted string representation.

A huge thank you to Mindbourne for their AP Maths videos on matrices.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
